title: WorkContainer v1 (DRAFT / CANDIDATE)
$comment: STATUS: DRAFT/CANDIDATE — non-binding until ratified and a first conforming implementation exists. This schema exports names for existing AG law; it does not create a new authority surface. WorkContainer carries admitted work across provider boundaries. It does NOT admit work, grant standing, or replace RationCard/ReviewPacket/governed_dispatch. Every field projects a shipped AG object; no field mints authority. See docs/api/work-container-contract.md.

sha256Ref.description: Content-addressed reference. Discipline reused from gate_receipt.canonical_json + sha256 hex.

capabilityClass.$comment: projects from: chain_gate.CapabilityClass — reused verbatim, not a new enum.

origin.$comment: projects from: plan_review.Proposal (proposal_ref) / playbooks PlaybookSpec|QueuedPlaybook digest (playbook_ref) / standing_client (standing_basis_ref). does not mint: standing.

submitted_by.description: Actor label, e.g. 'agent:claude-code'. Label only, not standing.

standing_basis_ref.description: Reference to the standing verification receipt. Not a grant; a citation.

intent.description: One-sentence outcome. Advisory prose, not a permission.

scope.$comment: projects from: playbooks.RationCard allowed_write_paths + QueuedPlaybook allowed_paths/forbidden_paths. Read-only copy; never re-derived, never expanded.

ration.$comment: projects from: playbooks.RationCard (ration_card.py) locked axes. does not replace RationCard; carries a read-only projection of it. does not grant permission.

capability_requirements.description: CapabilityClass values a provider must support to accept this container.

acceptance.$comment: projects from: plan-envelope-v0 acceptance_criteria + required outputs.

stop_conditions.$comment: projects from: plan-envelope-v0 stop_conditions (halt_if / forbidden_paths / budget).

receipt_expectations.$comment: projects from: gate_receipt.GateReceipt + ReviewPacket. Declares what testimony the provider must return; does not itself certify anything.

custody.$comment: projects from: gate_receipt.canonical_json seal + RecompositionReceipt lineage. does not mint: authority. decomposition_lineage records custody; recomposition can only refuse (RecompositionRefusal).

digest.description: Seal over the canonical container body.
